EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: EVM private key (0x-prefixed) — gas wallet for settlement transactions. Generate a new burner key; never use a main wallet.

EVM_PAY_TO_ADDRESS.description: Your USDC receiver address (where settled funds go). If empty, defaults to the EVM_PRIVATE_KEY address.

RPC_URL.description: Base mainnet RPC URL. Override if using a private RPC (Alchemy, Infura, etc.).

RPC_URL_SEPOLIA.description: Base Sepolia RPC URL (testnet). Override if using a private RPC.

PORT.description: Server port. Railway maps this to the public domain.
